title: Edge count under vertex relabeling
statement: Let $v$ be a natural number, let $G$ assign a Boolean value to each two-element subset of the $v$ vertices, and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of the vertices. The number of edges of the relabeled graph equals the number of edges of $G$.
